overview_description: Create, read, amend, cancel, reactivate and delete invoices, and reach their lines, notes, files, fulfillments and returns.
intro: An invoice bills an account for items, either on its own or raised from an order. This area has 30 endpoints: create, read, update, amend, cancel, reactivate and delete invoices; raise an invoice for an order; read their lines, KPIs and PDF links; add, read and delete notes and note files; and read their fulfillments, return merchandise authorisations and custom objects. Every SDK supports all of them.
warning: **`GET /invoices/{invoice_id}/lines/{line_id}` ignores `line_id` and always returns the invoice's first line.** Deleting a note file currently returns `404` `attachment not found`, even for a file the note's files listing shows.
notes: **Pass an invoice's `id`, never its `uuid`.** Every `{invoice_id}` is the invoice's `id`, such as `INV-0001`.

**Write bodies go under an `invoice` key.** Create, update, amend, cancel and reactivate all wrap their fields in `invoice`. Amend, cancel, reactivate and creating an invoice for an order also work with no body.
**Money comes back as text.** Amounts such as `total`, `subtotal` and `due` are strings like `"12.00"`. `discount_amount` and a line's tax `rate` are numbers.
**The invoice listing pages by cursor.** Records are under `data`. Pass `pagination.next_cursor` back as `cursor` while `pagination.has_more` is `true`.
**Only a single read carries the lines.** A listing entry has no `lines`; retrieve the invoice, or list its lines, to see them.
**Some reads under an invoice do not check the invoice.** The credit note application read returns any application under any invoice that exists.

endpoints.title: List invoices
endpoints.summary: Returns one page of invoices, with a cursor for the next page.
endpoints.description: Lists every invoice you can see, one page at a time. The records are under `data` and the paging details under `pagination`. A listed invoice does not include its `lines`; retrieve the invoice to get them. To filter, add `filter_<field>=<value>`, or `filter_<field>_<operator>=<value>` with an operator such as `gte` or `contains`.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: The most records to return on one page.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: The `next_cursor` value from the previous page, to fetch the page after it.

200.description: One page of invoices, under `data`, with `pagination`.

endpoints.title: Retrieve an invoice
endpoints.summary: Returns one invoice by its `id`, including its lines.
endpoints.description: Fetches a single invoice. Unlike a listing entry, the result carries the invoice's `lines`. Amounts such as `total` are strings.

parameters.name: invoice_id
parameters.description: The invoice's `id`, such as `INV-0001`. Not its `uuid`.

endpoints.title: Retrieve an invoice's information
endpoints.summary: Returns an invoice's core information, without its lines.
endpoints.description: Fetches the invoice's header details: status, dates, totals, account, currency and custom attributes. Use it when you do not need the lines.

parameters.name: invoice_id
parameters.description: The invoice's `id`, such as `INV-0001`. Not its `uuid`.

endpoints.title: Retrieve an invoice's PDF links
endpoints.summary: Returns links to the invoice's PDF, not the PDF file itself.
endpoints.description: Returns a small JSON description of the invoice's PDF under `invoice.pdf`, with a `preview_url`, a `download_url` and the `file_size`. Fetch `download_url` to get the file.

parameters.name: invoice_id
parameters.description: The invoice's `id`, such as `INV-0001`. Not its `uuid`.

endpoints.title: Create an invoice
endpoints.summary: Creates an invoice for an account and returns it.
endpoints.description: Creates an invoice from the fields under `invoice`. A new invoice has `status` `active` and `payment_status` `unpaid`. Send `price_tax_inclusive` as a JSON boolean.

account_id.description: The `id` of the account to bill.

endpoints.title: Update an invoice's information
endpoints.summary: Changes an invoice's note or customer purchase order number and returns the invoice.
endpoints.description: Updates the invoice's header fields sent under `invoice`, such as `invoice_note` and `customer_purchase_order_id`. Fields you leave out keep their values.

parameters.name: invoice_id
parameters.description: The invoice's `id`, such as `INV-0001`. Not its `uuid`.

endpoints.title: Amend an invoice
endpoints.summary: Adds, changes or removes invoice lines and returns the invoice.
endpoints.description: Amends the invoice's lines. Each entry of `invoice.lines` names an `op`: `add` with the new line under `value`, `change` with the line's `id` as `charge_item_uuid` and the new price or quantity, or `remove` with the line's `id` as `charge_item_uuid`. Each amendment raises the invoice's `version` by one. The body is optional.

parameters.name: invoice_id
parameters.description: The invoice's `id`, such as `INV-0001`. Not its `uuid`.

charge_item_uuid.description: For `change` and `remove`: the `id` of the invoice line.

endpoints.title: Cancel an invoice
endpoints.summary: Cancels an invoice and returns it with `status` `inactive`.
endpoints.description: Cancels the invoice. An empty `invoice` object is enough, and the body is optional. Cancelling an invoice that is already cancelled returns a client error.

parameters.name: invoice_id
parameters.description: The invoice's `id`, such as `INV-0001`. Not its `uuid`.

endpoints.title: Reactivate an invoice
endpoints.summary: Reactivates a cancelled invoice and returns it with `status` `active`.
endpoints.description: Brings a cancelled invoice back to `active`. An empty `invoice` object is enough, and the body is optional.

parameters.name: invoice_id
parameters.description: The invoice's `id`, such as `INV-0001`. Not its `uuid`.

endpoints.title: Delete an invoice
endpoints.summary: Deletes an invoice.
endpoints.description: Deletes the invoice. Afterwards a read of the same `id` returns `404`.

parameters.name: invoice_id
parameters.description: The invoice's `id`, such as `INV-0001`. Not its `uuid`.

204.description: The invoice is deleted. The response has no body.

endpoints.title: List an invoice's item fulfillments
endpoints.summary: Returns one page of the item fulfillments recorded against an invoice.
endpoints.description: Lists the fulfillments against the invoice, one page at a time, under `data`.

parameters.name: invoice_id
parameters.description: The invoice's `id`, such as `INV-0001`. Not its `uuid`.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: The most records to return on one page.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: The `next_cursor` value from the previous page, to fetch the page after it.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: The field to sort by. Put `-` in front for descending order, such as `-created_on`.

200.description: One page of item fulfillments, under `data`, with `pagination`.

endpoints.title: Retrieve an invoice's item fulfillment
endpoints.summary: Returns one item fulfillment recorded against an invoice.
endpoints.description: Fetches a single fulfillment of the invoice. A fulfillment that belongs to a different invoice returns `404`.

parameters.name: invoice_id
parameters.description: The invoice's `id`, such as `INV-0001`. Not its `uuid`.

parameters.name: fulfillment_id
parameters.description: The item fulfillment's `id`, which starts with `ifm_`.

404.description: The fulfillment does not belong to this invoice, or does not exist.

endpoints.title: List an invoice's return merchandise authorisations
endpoints.summary: Returns one page of the return merchandise authorisations raised against an invoice.
endpoints.description: Lists the invoice's return merchandise authorisations, one page at a time, under `data`. The path uses the British spelling `authorisations`; the spelling with a `z` returns `404`.

parameters.name: invoice_id
parameters.description: The invoice's `id`, such as `INV-0001`. Not its `uuid`.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: The most records to return on one page.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: The `next_cursor` value from the previous page, to fetch the page after it.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: The field to sort by. Put `-` in front for descending order, such as `-created_on`.

200.description: One page of return merchandise authorisations, under `data`, with `pagination`.

endpoints.title: Retrieve an invoice's return merchandise authorisation
endpoints.summary: Returns one return merchandise authorisation raised against an invoice.
endpoints.description: Fetches a single return merchandise authorisation of the invoice, with its lines. One that belongs to a different invoice returns `404`.

parameters.name: invoice_id
parameters.description: The invoice's `id`, such as `INV-0001`. Not its `uuid`.

parameters.name: rma_id
parameters.description: The return merchandise authorisation's `id`.

404.description: The return merchandise authorisation does not belong to this invoice, or does not exist.

endpoints.title: List an invoice's notes
endpoints.summary: Returns one page of the notes on an invoice.
endpoints.description: Lists the invoice's notes, one page at a time, under `data`. Each note carries its `content`, its `attachments` and who created it.

parameters.name: invoice_id
parameters.description: The invoice's `id`, such as `INV-0001`. Not its `uuid`.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: The most records to return on one page.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: The `next_cursor` value from the previous page, to fetch the page after it.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: The field to sort by. Put `-` in front for descending order, such as `-created_on`.

200.description: One page of notes, under `data`, with `pagination`.

endpoints.title: Retrieve an invoice note
endpoints.summary: Returns one note on an invoice.
endpoints.description: Fetches a single note by the `id` the notes listing gives it.

parameters.name: invoice_id
parameters.description: The invoice's `id`, such as `INV-0001`. Not its `uuid`.

parameters.name: note_id
parameters.description: The note's `id`, as the invoice's notes listing returns it.

endpoints.title: Create an invoice note
endpoints.summary: Adds a note, and optionally a file, to an invoice and returns the note.
endpoints.description: Sends a multipart form: the text as the `note` field and any attachment as `file`. The new note comes back with its `id` and the `uuid` of each attachment.

parameters.name: invoice_id
parameters.description: The invoice's `id`, such as `INV-0001`. Not its `uuid`.

file.description: An optional file to attach to the note.

example.note: Customer asked for a copy by post.

example_call.note: Customer asked for a copy by post.

endpoints.title: Delete an invoice note
endpoints.summary: Deletes a note from an invoice.
endpoints.description: Deletes the note. Afterwards a read of the same note returns `404`.

parameters.name: invoice_id
parameters.description: The invoice's `id`, such as `INV-0001`. Not its `uuid`.

parameters.name: note_id
parameters.description: The note's `id`, as the invoice's notes listing returns it.

204.description: The note is deleted. The response has no body.

endpoints.title: List an invoice note's files
endpoints.summary: Returns the files attached to a note on an invoice.
endpoints.description: Lists the note's attachments under `data`, each with its `uuid`, `filename`, `content_type`, `size` and `href`.

parameters.name: invoice_id
parameters.description: The invoice's `id`, such as `INV-0001`. Not its `uuid`.

parameters.name: note_id
parameters.description: The note's `id`, as the invoice's notes listing returns it.

endpoints.title: Retrieve an invoice note file
endpoints.summary: Returns the details of one file attached to a note, not the file's contents.
endpoints.description: Fetches a JSON description of the attachment under `file`: its `uuid`, `filename`, `content_type`, `size` and `href`.

parameters.name: invoice_id
parameters.description: The invoice's `id`, such as `INV-0001`. Not its `uuid`.

parameters.name: note_id
parameters.description: The note's `id`, as the invoice's notes listing returns it.

parameters.name: file_id
parameters.description: The attachment's `uuid`, from the note's `attachments`.

endpoints.title: List an order's invoices
endpoints.summary: Returns one page of the invoices raised for an order.
endpoints.description: Lists the invoices of one order, one page at a time, under `data`. Each record has the same fields as an entry of the invoice listing.

parameters.name: order_id
parameters.description: The order's `id`.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: The most records to return on one page.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: The `next_cursor` value from the previous page, to fetch the page after it.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: The field to sort by. Put `-` in front for descending order, such as `-created_on`.

200.description: One page of the order's invoices, under `data`, with `pagination`.

endpoints.title: Create an invoice for an order
endpoints.summary: Raises an invoice against an order and returns it.
endpoints.description: Creates an invoice for the order's lines. The body is optional; send fields such as `invoice_note` under `invoice`. The account's `invoice_mode` may need to be `MANUAL`.

parameters.name: order_id
parameters.description: The order's `id`.

endpoints.title: Retrieve an invoice's KPIs
endpoints.summary: Returns an invoice's key figures, such as payment applied and amount outstanding.
endpoints.description: Fetches the invoice's KPI block under `invoice_kpis`, the same block a retrieved invoice carries as `kpis`. Amounts such as `payment_applied` are strings.

parameters.name: invoice_id
parameters.description: The invoice's `id`, such as `INV-0001`. Not its `uuid`.

endpoints.title: List an invoice's lines
endpoints.summary: Returns all the lines of an invoice.
endpoints.description: Fetches the invoice's lines under `invoice.lines`. This is not a paged listing: every line comes back at once.

parameters.name: invoice_id
parameters.description: The invoice's `id`, such as `INV-0001`. Not its `uuid`.

endpoints.title: Retrieve an invoice line
endpoints.summary: Returns one line of an invoice.
endpoints.description: Fetches a line under `invoice.line`. The server ignores `line_id` and always returns the invoice's first line, so use the lines endpoint to find a specific one.

parameters.name: invoice_id
parameters.description: The invoice's `id`, such as `INV-0001`. Not its `uuid`.

parameters.name: line_id
parameters.description: The line's `id`. The server ignores it and returns the invoice's first line.

endpoints.title: Retrieve a credit note application through an invoice
endpoints.summary: Returns one credit note application by its `id`.
endpoints.description: Fetches a credit note application under `credit_note_application`. The server does not check that the application belongs to the invoice: any application is returned under any invoice that exists.

parameters.name: invoice_id
parameters.description: The invoice's `id`, such as `INV-0001`. Not its `uuid`.

parameters.name: credit_note_application_id
parameters.description: The credit note application's `id`.

endpoints.title: List an invoice's custom objects
endpoints.summary: Returns one page of the custom objects defined for invoices.
endpoints.description: Lists the custom objects defined for invoices, one page at a time, under `data`.

parameters.name: invoice_id
parameters.description: The invoice's `id`, such as `INV-0001`. Not its `uuid`.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: The most records to return on one page.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: The `next_cursor` value from the previous page, to fetch the page after it.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: The field to sort by. Put `-` in front for descending order, such as `-created_on`.

200.description: One page of custom objects, under `data`, with `pagination`.

endpoints.title: Retrieve an invoice's custom object
endpoints.summary: Returns one custom object with this invoice's instances of it.
endpoints.description: Fetches a custom object defined for invoices, together with the instances of it that belong to this invoice.

parameters.name: invoice_id
parameters.description: The invoice's `id`, such as `INV-0001`. Not its `uuid`.

parameters.name: custom_object_id
parameters.description: The custom object's `id`, which starts with `co_`.

200.description: The custom object and this invoice's instances of it.

endpoints.warning: **This call has not been confirmed to work.** The response body is not documented yet.

endpoints.title: Retrieve an invoice's custom object instance
endpoints.summary: Returns one instance of a custom object on an invoice.
endpoints.description: Fetches a single instance of a custom object that belongs to this invoice.

parameters.name: invoice_id
parameters.description: The invoice's `id`, such as `INV-0001`. Not its `uuid`.

parameters.name: custom_object_id
parameters.description: The custom object's `id`, which starts with `co_`.

parameters.name: instance_id
parameters.description: The custom object instance's `id`, which starts with `coi_`.

endpoints.warning: **This call has not been confirmed to work.** The response body is not documented yet.

endpoints.title: Delete an invoice note file
endpoints.summary: Deletes one file from a note on an invoice.
endpoints.description: Deletes the attachment by its `uuid`. A delete returns `204` with no body.

parameters.name: invoice_id
parameters.description: The invoice's `id`, such as `INV-0001`. Not its `uuid`.

parameters.name: note_id
parameters.description: The note's `id`, as the invoice's notes listing returns it.

parameters.name: file_id
parameters.description: The attachment's `uuid`, from the note's `attachments`.

204.description: The file is deleted. The response has no body.

404.description: `attachment not found`, returned even for a file the note's files listing shows.

endpoints.warning: **This call currently returns `404`.** The message is `attachment not found`, even for a file the note's files listing shows.

lines.description: Returned by Retrieve an invoice and by the invoice writes. A listing entry and Retrieve an invoice's information leave it out.

item.description: A reference to the item, with `object`, `id`, `name` and `href`.

has_more.description: Whether another page follows. Trust this over `next_cursor`, which can be stale on the last page.
